method: Per-channel sRGB gradient-stop/alpha bounds of actual computed ancestor layers; includes hero grid pseudo at full mask coverage and text glow; opaque child backgrounds occlude prior layers. One byte rounding margin. Resource-card top line excluded only with recorded positive target-box clearance. All targets match original production selectors exactly.
limitations: Bound model for measured normal state, not pixelwise colour sampling, actual native hover, arbitrary sibling overlap, PDF or full criterion approval. Visual review and source/geometry checks recorded separately.
